title: Combine generic curve completion, finite radicial realization and spreading
statement:
Let $S$ be a reduced affine scheme and $f:X	o S$ a separated morphism of finite presentation [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $\eta$ be the generic point of an irreducible component of $S$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] [def-sc-generic-point], and assume $\dim X_\eta\leq1$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre] [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. There exist an open neighbourhood $U\subset S$ of $\eta$, a finite surjective universally injective morphism $V	o U$, a finite family of finite etale morphisms $T_i	o V$, and commutative diagrams over $V$ $$\coprod_iY_i\xrightarrow{
u}X_V:=X	imes_SV,\qquad Y_i\xrightarrow{j_i}\overline Y_i	o T_i	o V$$ [def-pc-fibre-product] [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family] [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], with the following properties. The map $
u$ is finite and surjective; each $j_i$ is an open immersion; $Y_i	o T_i$ is smooth and surjective; $\overline Y_i	o T_i$ is smooth and proper with geometrically connected fibres of dimension at most one [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There is an open $W\subset X_V$ such that $W_i:=
u^{-1}(W)\cap Y_i$ meets every fibre of $Y_i	o T_i$, and $
u^{-1}(W)	o W$ is a thickening, meaning a closed immersion surjective on underlying points [def-sbc-first-order-thickening]. No density assertion is part of this statement. The finite family may be empty.

proof.text: Apply the field curve completion theorem to X_eta over kappa(eta). It supplies a finite purely inseparable extension K and the entire componentwise normalization and smooth projective completion diagram, including all finite-presentation and qcqs hypotheses.
Realize K on a reduced affine finite radicial cover of an affine open neighbourhood of eta. Keep its generic point and the compatible residue-field isomorphism.

Install the supplied affine, reduced and morphism-property instances and apply the prescribed-generic-diagram spreading theorem. Its hypotheses are exactly the field diagram and residue-field compatibility produced by the preceding steps.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_good_curves_reduced_affine_nonempty_thickening
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsReduced S] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (η : S) (hη : ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents S, IsGenericPoint η Z)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber η) ≤ 1) :
    ∃ (U : S.Opens) (_ : η ∈ U) (V : Scheme.{u}) (g : V ⟶ U.toScheme),
      IsFinite g ∧ Surjective g ∧ UniversallyInjective g ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (T Y Ybar : Fin n → Scheme.{u})
        (t : ∀ i, T i ⟶ V) (j : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ Ybar i)
        (p : ∀ i, Ybar i ⟶ T i)
        (ν : (∐ Y) ⟶ pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)),
        IsFinite ν ∧ Surjective ν ∧
        (∀ i, Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν ≫ pullback.snd f (g ≫ U.ι) = j i ≫ p i ≫ t i) ∧
        (∀ i, IsFinite (t i) ∧ Etale (t i)) ∧
        (∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (j i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Smooth (j i ≫ p i) ∧ Surjective (j i ≫ p i)) ∧
        (∀ i, Smooth (p i) ∧ IsProper (p i) ∧
          ∀ s : T i, GeometricallyConnected ((p i).fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
            topologicalKrullDim ((p i).fiber s) ≤ 1) ∧
        ∃ W : (pullback f (g ≫ U.ι)).Opens,
          (∀ (i : Fin n) (s : T i),
            ∃ y : (j i ≫ p i).fiber s,
              ((j i ≫ p i).fiberι s ≫ Sigma.ι Y i ≫ ν) y ∈ W) ∧
          IsThickening (pullback.snd ν W.ι)
